name: Shanavaur
questions: Daft shows BER C but no sub-band or kWh figure (cert no. 120016175); can you send the full BER certificate and advisory report? What is the main heating system and fuel, besides the two stoves?
How big is the site in acres, and does it include the field north-east of the house? Can you send the folio map, and is the boundary dog-proof all round?
Are Room 5 and Room 6 in the attic covered by planning and building regulations for habitable use (head height, fire escape)? Is there any bathroom or WC upstairs, or plumbing for one?
Is there a floor plan with room sizes? How big are the three ground-floor bedrooms?
What is the yard about 100 m east along the lane used for, and is water from mains, a group scheme or a well? Is drainage a septic tank, and when was it last inspected?

ai.why: A well-kept 197 m² dormer bungalow with all three main bedrooms and the family bathroom on the ground floor, landscaped gardens set well back, and Portlaoise's ED and Dublin trains about 15 minutes away, at €475k. Held back by two attic rooms with no bathroom upstairs, an unstated site size and heating, and a working yard about 100 m east.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; not stated, but the house is lived in and well kept.

water.detail: Not stated; mains, group scheme or private well all possible in the Slieve Bloom foothills.

sewer.detail: Not stated; a rural house set back on its own site almost certainly has its own septic tank or treatment system.

internet.detail: Full fibre at the address per BuyerIQ ('101 Mb full fibre'); the listing doesn't mention broadband. Provider not confirmed, most likely NBI in this rural area.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Three bedrooms on the ground floor, including the principal with its own tiled en suite, plus a ground-floor family bathroom with bath and separate shower; room sizes aren't given.

bedsNote: Three bedrooms on the ground floor plus two large attic rooms (Room 5 and Room 6) under sloping ceilings with roof windows; Daft counts 4 beds
heating: Not stated; an inset stove in the sitting room and a stove in the dining area's brick fireplace
tagline: A well-kept 197 m² dormer bungalow with three ground-floor bedrooms and landscaped gardens, set back off a lane in the Slieve Bloom foothills 5 km north of Mountrath and about 15 minutes from Portlaoise.

pros.detail: About €2,411/m² for 197 m²; stamp duty about €4,750.

pros.text: Three ground-floor bedrooms and a full bathroom
pros.detail: The principal bedroom has an en suite; the ground-floor family bathroom has a full bath and separate shower, and there's a guest WC by the rear hall.

pros.text: Portlaoise about 15 minutes: ED, trains, shops
pros.detail: Midland Regional Hospital Portlaoise has a 24-hour ED with a paediatric extension opened in May 2026; Portlaoise station has frequent Heuston trains.

pros.text: 197 m² with a big kitchen-dining room
pros.detail: Kitchen with island and breakfast bar, a dining area with exposed brick fireplace and stove, glazed doors to a decked terrace, plus a sitting room with stove and a large utility.

pros.text: Landscaped gardens, set well back from the lane
pros.detail: Sweeping drive with two entrances around a front lawn, mature trees, a decked terrace with pergola, a fenced rear patio and sheds; fields and forestry to the west and south.
Paddock NS, about 80 pupils (34 boys, 46 girls), Catholic, co-ed; Mountrath Community School (about 800 pupils) is 5 km.
BuyerIQ shows 101 Mb full fibre for R32 HP64.

cons.text: No bathroom upstairs; attic rooms may not be bedrooms
cons.detail: Room 5 and Room 6 are attic rooms under sloping ceilings with roof windows, named 'rooms' not bedrooms; whoever sleeps up there comes down for every bathroom trip. Check head height, fire escape and planning.

cons.text: Site size, heating, water and drainage not stated
cons.detail: The listing gives no acreage, main heating fuel, water source or septic details; from the aerial the house plot with its looped drive looks about 0.2–0.3 ha, more if the field to the north-east comes with it.

cons.text: A working yard about 100 m east
cons.detail: Satellite shows sheds, vehicles and stacked materials in a yard about 100 m east along the lane, a neighbouring house about 65 m east and another about 95 m north; use not known.

cons.text: BER C with no sub-band or kWh figure
cons.detail: Daft shows only 'C' (cert 120016175), not exempt as first noted; C1–C3 is 150–225 kWh/m²/yr, so ask for the certificate.

cons.text: Mapped flood zone about 0.4 km away
cons.detail: BuyerIQ flags moderate river flood risk with a mapped zone ~0.4 km from the address; the house itself isn't shown in it. Get an insurance quote with flood cover.

cons.text: No floor plan or room sizes
cons.detail: The listing gives only the 197 m² total; bedroom and kitchen sizes are unknown.
Paddock NS is 2.1 km and Mountrath about 5 km down rural lanes; no footpaths to the school or shop.
